implementation_strategy: Use hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter calling the hosted model API (gpt-5-mini) for one shared initial generation per intent and at most one guarded repair call when the deterministic verifier fails. All verifier runs and mapping code execute on CPU/Docker runtime; no human labour. Session isolation per model call enforced; all logs, mapping inputs, verifier verdicts, and hashes recorded and published.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic programmatic generator with rule-based ambiguity filter applied prior to any model call; confirmatory corpus fixed N=150 after deterministic exclusions.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Deterministic prompt templates for baseline and constrained prompts; automated mapping code (parser+sanitizer) to produce verifier-compatible NetKAT/KATch inputs; generate→verify→repair loop implemented per adapter constraints (max one repair call).
randomisation_plan: None required; within-intent paired comparisons use shared initial candidate (shared_initial_candidate semantics).
caching_plan: Cache static artifacts (intent generator seeds, topology files). Do not cache or reuse model session state. Cache verifier results for reproducibility only; each model call runs in fresh API session.
failure_recovery_plan: One automatic retry for API timeouts or transient failures after fixed backoff. Mapping/unit-test failures abort the entire run deterministically. Parse failures or unsupported verifier features are excluded per preregistered exclusion rules and recorded.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-intent paired record containing shared initial candidate, baseline mapping/verifier verdict, guarded repair call (if any) and final verifier verdict, binary pass/fail flags for each condition, deterministic exclusion codes where applicable, and hashes of all artifacts.
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated model-call total = 150 initial calls + estimated 60 guarded repair calls = 210 model calls (<= max 300). All model calls via hosted openai_responses (gpt-5-mini). Verifier (KATch) and mapping code run on CPU (Docker) within 7 wall-clock days budget; model-call budget well within maximum_planned_model_calls=10000.
